desc:
TOILET is the new code! Redeem to get a free random toilet and all boosts for 10 minutes!

🔥 Welcome to Toilet Merge Simulator🔥

🚽 Get ready to unlock 15+ super cool, powerful toilets!
💩 Grab Poops from your toilets and toss them in the Trash to earn cash!
💸 Use your money to buy more toilets and level up faster!
♻️ Toilets will automatically merge every 10 floors to keep the game running smoothly!
💾 Tycoon progress saves automatically!

⭐ If you’re having fun, don’t forget to like the game and join our group!
